$comment: Unit tests skipped in `npm test`. Each entry needs a reason and a tracking issue. These are App Builder template tests under scripts/ (platform files we don't edit). They assert the template's defaults, which this app deliberately changed (sign-in on, custom share card, auth migration in migrations/), or read .grok/skills/, which is gitignored and absent in a clean checkout. They fail identically on main at ed0a42c.
